newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso closes firmer in correction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso closes firmer in correction.

text.p: The Mexican same-day peso closed 2.65 centavos firmer at 7.8050/7.8135 per dollar on Thursday in what traders said was a much calmer session than Wednesday when speculation ruled the day.

"The peso was battered yesterday and lost a lot of ground. Things are a lot calmer now and some dollars are in supply...," said a trader. "Today's relative recovery can be explained by banks selling (dollar) positions that they bought yesterday."
The still-trading benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart were meanwhile 0.7 and 1.7 centavos firmer, respectively, at 7.8380/7.8430 and 7.8230/7.8280 per dollar.
Traders said that the peso's relative recovery was also due to dealers changing dollars into pesos to have them ready to invest in the money market over the weekend.
Furthermore, markets were optimistic that inflation figures due to be released later during the day would be down on September. Traders said this was also aiding the peso.
A Reuters survey of economists showed an average forecast of 0.74 percent for the first half of October, compared to 1.6 percent for the whole of September.
